name: @muxos/plugin-infra-spawn-daemon-bundle
description: bundleDaemon: a detached daemon's entry bundled into a self-contained, content-addressed directory it runs from instead of a checkout — repo code and pure-JS packages inlined, path-run scripts bundled beside it, external packages cloned, sealed dependency installs linked — held by an in-use flock the daemon inherits, unheld bundles reclaimed by the next call.
